sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 600. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Miracle.
-Target: all allies. Activates Time Extend which increases the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 70 seconds for one time only.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 40.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 100 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
-Applies Time Qualia (increases all stats by 100%, increases time elemental attack by 10, increases time elemental defense by 150, and nullifies Miasma and Beguilement) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 30000
Confuse and Prohibit Unison Resistance Up by 60
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies iron wall for 120 seconds.
